titulo.estudio: Источник и цитата в научном тексте
titulo.alumno:
«Источник и цитата в научном тексте»
Sources and quotations in a scientific text

intro: Look for who formulates each claim and which source supports it; an attributed quotation is not the same as the author's own conclusion.

frases.estudio: Согласно отчёту университета, число заявок выросло на 12 процентов.
frases.alumno: According to the university report, the number of applications rose by 12 per cent.

frases.estudio: Авторы ссылаются на данные за три года, а собственный вывод формулируют отдельно.
frases.alumno: The authors cite three years of data and state their own conclusion separately.

piezas.titulo: Look for who formulates each claim and which source supports it; an attributed quotation is not the same as the author's own conclusion.
texto: Look for who formulates each claim and which source supports it; an attributed quotation is not the same as the author's own conclusion.
Forms such as согласно отчёту and по данным авторов attribute the information and limit its scope.

pregunta.texto: Which expression attributes the figure to a source?

opciones.explicacion: Согласно identifies the report the figure comes from.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Согласно отчёту университета, число заявок выросло на 12 процентов.»

frase.texto: Согласно отчёту университета, число заявок выросло на 12 процентов.

opciones.texto: According to the university report, the number of applications rose by 12 per cent.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The authors cite three years of data and state their own conclusion separately.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Авторы ссылаются на данные за три года, а собственный вывод формулируют отдельно

piezas.traduccion: The authors cite three years of data and state their own conclusion separately.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
